name: Legislation / Bill Tracker

parameters.content:
## Legislation / Bill Tracker

### How it works

1. The workflow triggers daily and weekly schedules to track legislation and generate digests.
2. It searches LegiScan using configured terms and compares results against a Google Sheets tracker.
3. New or status-changed bills are filtered and drafted into alert digests for review.
4. The workflow logs drafts and sends review request emails to designated recipients.
5. Weekly, it summarizes the entire tracked bill landscape and sends a landscape summary email.


### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure LegiScan API credentials for HTTP requests.
- [ ] Set up and share the Google Sheets tracker with appropriate access.
- [ ] Configure email credentials for sending review requests and summaries.
- [ ] Define search terms in environment variables or workflow parameters for legislation tracking.
- [ ] Schedule triggers for daily tracking and weekly landscape rollup.

### Customization

Adjust the search terms format and email content templates to match organizational needs and terminology.

## Daily legislation tracking start

This group includes the initial daily trigger and conditional branch that checks if search terms are configured, determining whether the workflow proceeds to search legislation or drafts a setup notice.

## Build and execute search queries

This group builds LegiScan search queries based on configured terms, executes HTTP requests to LegiScan API to search legislation, and parses the search results.

## Compare and update bill tracker

This cluster reads the current bill tracker Google Sheet, compares search results to track new or changed bills, and updates the tracker sheet accordingly.

## Filter and draft alert digest

Filters alert-worthy bills (new or status-changed), drafts a keyword-driven alert digest, or drafts a setup-needed notice if search terms are not configured.

## Finalize and send review request

Assigns unique digest IDs, logs the draft digest into Google Sheets, builds the review request email, and sends it out.

## Weekly landscape summary start

Weekly schedule trigger and read full bill tracker to start the legislative landscape rollup process.

## Summarize and send landscape email

Computes summary of the full tracked bill landscape by practice area, builds the landscape summary email, and sends it.

nodes.name: When Daily at 7 AM
nodes.notes: Runs daily, 7am by default.

nodes.name: If Search Terms Present
nodes.notes: Checked here, while there's still guaranteed exactly one item from the trigger -- an unconfigured LEGISLATION_SEARCH_TERMS routes to a setup-needed notice instead of the run silently dying at zero items.

nodes.name: Build Legislation Search Queries
nodes.notes: One item per (practice area, search term) pair from LEGISLATION_SEARCH_TERMS.

nodes.name: Fetch LegiScan Search Results
nodes.notes: Runs once per (practice area, term) pair from the previous step. LEGISCAN_API_KEY is a plain n8n Variable, not a credential -- LegiScan's API takes it as a query-string token. Free-tier accounts have a daily query cap; keep LEGISLATION_SEARCH_TERMS reasonably short if you're tracking many areas.

nodes.name: Parse LegiScan Search Results
nodes.notes: LegiScan's numeric status codes (e.g. 1=Introduced) aren't hardcoded to a label here -- the alert blurb below matches on the free-text last_action instead, which is more reliable across LegiScan's own documented status table changes.

nodes.name: Read Bill Tracker Sheets
nodes.notes: The firm/Protomated's own record of every bill previously seen and its last-known status.

nodes.name: Compare Bills to Tracker
nodes.notes: Reads matched results from 'Parse Search Results' by name, not $json, since this node's own input is the Bill Tracker sheet read, not the search results.

nodes.name: Update Bill Tracker Sheets
nodes.notes: Updates every matched bill's tracker row, whether or not its status changed -- keeps last_checked_at current and creates a new row for bills tracked for the first time. Uses Append or Update Row, matched on bill_id.

nodes.name: Filter Alert-Worthy Bills
nodes.notes: Reads from 'Compare Against Bill Tracker' by name, not $input, since the Sheets update node in between echoes back its own written rows, not the original is_new/status_changed flags.

nodes.name: Draft Legislation Alert Digest
nodes.notes: Runs once for the whole batch — turns alert-worthy bills into a single digest draft, explicitly noting when nothing changed rather than sending an empty draft.

nodes.name: Draft Setup Needed Notice
nodes.notes: Fires only when LEGISLATION_SEARCH_TERMS is empty -- keeps the digest email showing up on schedule even before tracking is configured.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { item_count: 0, area_count: 0, draft_content: '(no search terms configured yet -- set LEGISLATION_SEARCH_TERMS in n8n Variables)', bills_by_area: [] } }];

nodes.name: Assign Digest Identifier
nodes.notes: Ties the sheet row to this run.

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $json;
return { json: { ...d, digest_id: 'BILLALERT-' + Date.now(), created_at: new Date().toISOString() } };

nodes.name: Append Digest Draft To Sheets
nodes.notes: Every daily run gets a row here, even a 'nothing changed' one. Column headers must match exactly.

nodes.name: Build Digest Review Email
nodes.notes: Reads deal-equivalent fields back from 'Assign Digest ID' by name, not $json -- the Sheets append node in between echoes back its own written row, not the original structured data. Falls back the recipient to FIRM_FROM_EMAIL if CONTENT_REVIEWER_EMAIL isn't set.

nodes.name: Send Digest Review Email
nodes.notes: Internal Protomated notification, not a client communication — no compliance guardrail wrap needed.

nodes.name: When Weekly on Monday at 8 AM
nodes.notes: Runs weekly, Monday 8am by default.

nodes.name: Read Full Bill Tracker Sheets
nodes.notes: Reads every bill currently being tracked, regardless of when it last changed.

nodes.name: Compute Landscape Summary
nodes.notes: Counts every actively tracked bill by practice area.

nodes.name: Build Landscape Summary Email
nodes.notes: Explicitly sends a 'nothing tracked' message rather than a blank digest when the tracker is empty.

nodes.name: Send Landscape Summary Email
nodes.notes: Internal, firm-wide summary — no guardrail wrap needed.

description: Internal Protomated tool, Authority pillar, not deployed to clients. Runs daily: searches LegiScan for each configured practice-area search term, compares matched bills against a maintained tracker sheet, flags anything new or status-changed, updates the tracker, drafts a plain-English alert digest grouped by practice area with a templated blurb keyed off the bill's own last-action text, logs the draft, and emails it to a content reviewer. Separately, a weekly rollup summarizes the full tracked bill landscape by practice area for newsletter/content planning. Nothing publishes without a human review pass. Replaces Bloomberg Government and FiscalNote for this specific use case.
